title: CPI inflation report August 2026: Prices rose 0.4%, annual rate 3.4%; core CPI beats estimates
summary: U.S. consumer prices rose a seasonally adjusted 0.4% in August, putting the 12-month increase at 3.4%, both in line with Dow Jones consensus. However, core CPI accelerated 0.3% for the month — 0.1pp above forecast — with the annual core rate at 2.4%. Gasoline prices jumped 3.9%, accounting for over one-third of the headline gain. U.S. equities closed higher on the day: Dow +0.98%, S&P 500 +0.86%, Nasdaq +0.96%, as oil prices retreated from weekly highs.
why: 8月核心CPI月率+0.3%超预期，确立9月16日FOMC加息至3.75-4.00%的路径（FedWatch加息概率升至86%）；高利率环境压制成长股估值；美股当日逆势收涨（油价回落缓解通胀担忧），但加息周期对sell put仓位的delta风险与隐含波动率需持续关注。

title: August consumer inflation cements Fed rate hike odds. What Wall Street is saying
summary: Wall Street consensus after August CPI: the FOMC is cleared to hike rates at the September 15-16 meeting, with traders pricing 86% odds of a 25bp move to 3.75-4.00%, likely followed by at least one additional hike by year-end. Services inflation ex-shelter ran at 6.3% annualized in August, suggesting underlying labor-market strength. Fed holds current target range at 3.50-3.75% since December 2025.
why: 美联储9月16日加息概率升至86%，市场定价终端利率或升至4.00%以上；持有科技/消费类港股及美股的投资者需重新评估高利率对估值的压制；对期权策略而言，加息消息落地前隐含波动率可能维持较高水平，利于sell put收息但需防止单边下跌风险。

title: PPI inflation report August 2026: Producer prices rose 0.4%, annual rate 5.4%, 0.1pp above estimates
summary: U.S. producer prices rose a seasonally adjusted 0.4% in August; the 12-month PPI came in at 5.4%, 0.1 percentage point above expectations. Final demand goods surged 1.1% while services rose 0.1%. Pipeline pressures intensified: processed goods +1.8%, unprocessed goods +1.1%. Core PPI ex-food/energy rose 0.2%, slightly below the 0.3% forecast.
why: PPI年率5.4%显示生产端通胀顽固，能源成本（油价受中东战事推高40%+）正向下游传导；与CPI同步走高排除了美联储年内降息可能；对消费/科技类高估值股票形成压力；sell put策略需留意加息周期中整体市场的下行波动。

title: Oil prices fall Friday but post sharp weekly gains as Middle East tensions rise; Brent near $106
summary: Brent crude eased to approximately $106/barrel on September 11 (-1.41%), retreating from a $108+ peak on September 10. The U.S.-Iran war continues to dominate: Iranian-backed Houthis struck Saudi energy facilities this week; Saudi Arabia's crude output fell roughly 1.9 million barrels/day in August. Oil prices remain up more than 40% since the conflict began, fueling global inflation concerns.
why: 中东战争推动油价年内累涨超40%，是当前全球通胀上行的核心驱动（美国PPI年率+5.4%，汽油分项+3.9%），强化了美联储加息预期；对持有消费（餐饮、旅游、出行）类标的如海底捞、携程的投资者需重新评估运营成本压力；原油价格波动率上升也提升整体市场VIX，影响期权定价。

title: Stock market news for Sept. 11, 2026: Hang Seng falls ~1%, China/HK stocks log worst week in months
summary: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index fell approximately 1% (-~257 points) to close near 24,691 on September 11, capping a weekly decline of 3.5% — the worst since April 2025. Mainland China's CSI 300 dropped 1.6% for the week; the Shanghai Composite lost 1.8%. Drivers: thin volumes, growing expectations of a U.S. rate hike next week, and Middle East tensions lifting oil above $108 mid-week. The Hang Seng Tech Index declined over 2% for the day.
why: 恒生指数周跌3.5%、科技指数周内跌幅超10%，加息预期+油价冲击是双重压力；持仓港股科技/消费板块（腾讯、美团、泡泡玛特等）均受波及；9月16日FOMC会议前市场将保持谨慎，sell put策略应关注行权价下方cushion是否仍充足。

title: China's wholesale inflation tops estimates in August on commodity costs, tech demand as consumer prices meet forecast
summary: China's August PPI topped analyst estimates, driven by elevated commodity costs (oil prices surging 40%+ on the U.S.-Iran conflict) and robust tech manufacturing demand. China's CPI came in at forecast. The data highlights China's exposure to imported inflation from global energy-price shocks, even as domestic consumer demand remains uneven.
why: 延续报道：中国8月PPI超预期，与美国PPI同步走高，共同指向全球能源驱动型通胀重新加速；A股制造/化工板块成本压力加大；中美通胀数据偏热使两国央行均无宽松空间，对成长股估值形成系统性压力；港股消费/科技龙头受中国消费数据偏弱影响亦需持续跟踪。

title: Enflame shares soar 188% on Shanghai debut as Nvidia challenger taps investor fever for AI
summary: Tencent-backed AI chipmaker Enflame Technology debuted on Shanghai's STAR Market on September 11, surging 188% above its IPO price of 142.18 yuan/share to close at 397 yuan, valuing the firm at ~CNY 185 billion (~$25.5 billion). The company raised $912 million in its IPO after drawing retail investor orders 4,073 times the shares available. Tencent holds a 20% stake and accounted for 83.79% of Enflame's 2025 revenue. Enflame targets the domestic AI training chip market, competing with Nvidia amid U.S. export controls.
why: 腾讯持股20%的燧原科技IPO首日暴涨188%，是腾讯AI投资布局的重要确认；但需注意：腾讯作为燧原科技最大客户（贡献其营收83.79%），客户集中度极高——燧原独立商业化仍需验证。A股科创板AI芯片热度高涨，国产替代主题受益于美出口管制；对持有腾讯（0700.HK）的投资者属情绪催化，但非直接财务影响。

title: NVIDIA and Palantir Bring Sovereign Intelligence to Critical Supply Chains
summary: NVIDIA and Palantir Technologies announced on September 10 a collaboration to deploy a sovereign AI stack for critical supply chain management, first deployed inside NVIDIA's own operations. The system integrates NVIDIA's Nemotron open models with Palantir Foundry and AIP (Artificial Intelligence Platform). Showcased at AIPCon 11, targeting agriculture, manufacturing, pharmaceutical, retail, technology, and government sectors.
why: NVIDIA与Palantir合作强化各自的AI平台商业化叙事：NVIDIA将AI应用从卖芯片延伸至供应链运营（垂直整合）；Palantir借此将AIP从政府/国防向商业供应链横向扩展（Q2美国商业营收+149% YoY，规则40达155%）；对持有NVDA和PLTR的投资者，这是双赢的合作，或维持市场对二者的高增长预期，隐含波动率保持高位有利于sell put策略收益。

title: 小米澎程明天全国交付，雷军又去哪儿开车门？引发热议
summary: 小米创始人雷军9月11日宣布，小米澎程（Sky Nomad）系列增程SUV将于9月12日正式开启全国交付，覆盖全国75个城市。首批交付车型包括N70 Pro（20.99万元）、N70 Max（23.99万元）等，价格区间20.99-29.99万元。这是小米汽车首次进入增程EREV赛道，完成纯电+增程双线战略布局。小米汽车累计交付量已超80万辆。
why: 小米澎程全国开交是里程碑事件，增程路线覆盖了更广泛家庭用车市场（无续航焦虑），有望推动Q3-Q4交付量进一步提升；对小米（1810.HK）是积极催化，与YU7叠加构成多产品矩阵；但目前处于中东+加息双重宏观压力下的港股弱势市场，催化弹性需关注大盘走势；投资者可观察交付量数据以判断sell covered call的时机。
